Team, initial triage attached (signup-cluster-20270301.csv). High-level summary:
- Volume: 32 new accounts created between 2027-03-01 01:05 and 03:12 UTC (≈2.1 hr).
- Domains: 78% use short disposable-looking domains (examples: fastmail-1.xyz, dev-fastrest.xyz, freetrialhq.xyz). Not standard company domains or well-known providers.
- Device fingerprints: 87% share 3 browser/device attributes (same UA string + identical canvas fingerprint subset), low entropy on timezone.
- Behavior: average tokens consumed per session < 180, sequences of repeated quick prompts (likely smoke tests).
- Rule hits: auto-grant-v2 flagged 27/32; heuristic 'rotating-subdomain-v1' triggered on 24 accounts.

Recommendation: Do NOT auto-approve blanket 48h top-ups yet. Pause auto-grants for FastRetail's org for new accounts matching these patterns and run a manual verification for the cohort. I attached the device-fingerprint-report.pdf and a CSV export.

If we want to offer a short path for legitimate devs, propose: 1) send a manual verification form to the signups (org email or team Slack confirmation); 2) permit 24h manual credits to verified accounts only; 3) continue monitoring the cohort for 48 hrs.

I'll also drop a Drive link with the raw logs: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1A2b3C_example_report
